gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed GBM at the time of diagnosis.

candidate_evidence.quote: [DRUG] ACT001: Phase1b - Starting approximately 2 weeks prior to the scheduled surgery, patient will receive an assigned dose of ACT001 by mouth

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: First or second relapse by the time of consenting.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: 2a-Concentration of ACT001 in resected tumor biopsy tissue.
Determine ACT001 trough levels in tumor samples.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Tumor resection will be performed and a biopsy will be obtained from the resected tumor tissue to evaluate the impact of the study drugs on the TME.

role_evidence.quote: 20 patients will be randomized to the ACT001 plus Pembrolizumab arm (Arm B).
The starting dose of ACT001 will be administered in combination with a single intravenous (IV) infusion of Pembrolizumab.

coder_notes: Pembrolizumab is not a separate registered intervention (it is named inside 'ACT001 + Pembrolizumab' and the arm text) but is given to every patient; it is also the Arm A comparator within the single registered 2a arm. Both ACT001 and pembrolizumab are investigational for GBM in the combination (Arm B), so both coded experimental_combination. Control arm (pembrolizumab only) sits inside an EXPERIMENTAL-labelled registered arm, hence control_arm_from_other_arms yes.
